reply:
Good afternoon Chidi,

I looked into transfer TRF-INV-88 for ₦250,000 to your Access Bank account 0234567891. Our system does show it as "failed," so I checked the final status directly with Access Bank — and they confirmed the funds were successfully credited to the recipient account on 21 November 2026 at 14:02. The confirmation session ID is 000014261121140211000088.

Since the recipient bank confirms the credit, I'm holding off on resending for now to avoid paying you twice. Please check with your bank branch or customer care using the session ID above — sometimes a credit is booked to the account but isn't immediately visible (for example, if it's pending posting or the account is under a hold).

If Access Bank confirms the money never landed in your account despite this confirmation, get back to me and I'll escalate it right away so we can resolve it.
